title: Out-of-Class Assignments
text: Students will complete out-of-class assignments including:

subsections.title: Reading
items: Read and review assigned textbook chapters and instructional materials.

subsections.title: Writing
items: Develop algorithms, flowcharts, and pseudocode to solve programming problems.
Create program design documents, code annotations, and written responses related to programming concepts.

subsections.title: Other
items: Design, code, test, and debug Python programs.
Complete assigned coding exercises, programming projects, and practice activities.
Analyze, test, debug, and evaluate program correctness and functionality.
